title: Lifts we've installed: the installs showcase

scenes.narration: Lifts we've installed is a new showcase on the website. Each listing is a lift FiberSteel put in, with FiberSteel's photos, the lift size, the boat and the slip. The ones in this demo are samples.
Boaters can narrow it down by boat type, by lift size, or by how the boat docks.
Each install has its photos, what was built for the boat, and a quote button for a lift like it.
The same installs show on each lift page, so the listings sell the lift and the custom work at the same time.
New installs can be added to the showcase over time.

Or, with FiberSteel mode, the listings can be uploaded and managed by FiberSteel's staff. FiberSteel mode is purely a demo of what's possible, and a real one would be customized. Its Website section lists recently finished install jobs, ready to post.
Posting one starts from the job, so the lift size, the boat, the slip, the docking, the town and the month are already filled in.
Then a few lines about the job.
Each photo gets a description, and the location data phones add is removed before it's saved.
It only goes up with the owners' OK, and it shows the town, never the address. This one also goes on the home page.
Saving queues it for the next publish, and one click publishes it.
And there it is: first on the installs page, and on the home page too, because it's featured.
The whole showcase has an on and off switch, so FiberSteel can keep it hidden until there are photos it's proud of.
Switched off, the lift pages simply skip it, and Our installs leaves the menu.
Switch it back on, and it's all there again.
